deviations_from_card: (1) No store `stale` map and no new CardView.stale field: the model already derives BoundTabView.moved/open from the tabs store on every tabs:changed, so case 2 ('says so with no press') is pinned at the slip (Sign renders Ask again here in place of Approve) rather than as a duplicate store map that would cost first-frame bytes. (2) staleOf lives in the lazy stores/ran.ts and takes the run store's binding check (staleOf(cards, refused)) instead of (cards, tabs, byTab), so ran.ts imports only types from run.ts (a value import split a new 'gate' chunk into the first frame, +765 B). (3) To fit the ratchet, mergeCards/cardFromRow (only run after GET /decisions answered) moved from run.ts to ran.ts, loaded inside reconcile through the existing ./ran dynamic import (no new dynamic import); run.test.ts imports them from ./ran (test-only change outside the write set). (4) boundTabSentence keeps its wording and its tail now says 'Ask again here.' instead of 'Decline it and ask again'. (5) Two-commit rollback collapsed into one commit. ADR 0211 written.
notes: First paint measured on an isolated build of HEAD (git archive into scratchpad, siblings excluded): 165,385 B before -> 165,127 B with this change (-258 B), so this commit frees ~258 B of headroom; the coordinator should run perf if wanted. The run.test.ts copy failure a sibling saw came from my in-flight sentence rewrite; the final sentence keeps 'reloaded or moved to another page' and run.test.ts is green. reconcile now awaits import('./ran') after the daemon answers (the lazy chunk is fetched just after the first frame). No sibling reds seen in the final full desktop run.
